title: Rule 20B, Rajasthan Land Revenue (Allotment of Land for Agricultural Purposes) Rules 1970
what_it_contains: Rule 20B: authorised officer may allot government agricultural land to families displaced from Mahajan Field Firing Range; total land equal to land lost, within ceiling; earlier allotment elsewhere must be cancelled first.
why_relevant: Legal basis for the pending allotment claims; the scheme-help desk must explain this rule and the documents needed.

title: देश के लिए भूमि देकर 40 साल से भटक रहे किसान (Rajasthan Patrika)
what_it_contains: 148 allotment cases pending in Colonisation dept; 350 farmers given forest land (double allotment); 17 Jan 2025 Revenue (Group-6) notification moved allotment power from Addl. Commissioner Colonisation to District Collector; Addl. Commissioner quoted that files await HQ orders.
why_relevant: Shows exactly where a family's pending 20B case now sits (Collector Bikaner) - the core of an allotment-tracker initiative.

title: कोलायत और बज्जू में 1400 बीघा भूमि का फर्जी आवंटन (Rajasthan Patrika)
what_it_contains: Assembly reply: 1400 bigha wrongly allotted in 69 allotments (2020-23) from land reserved for ex-servicemen/MFFR displaced; Collector-led inquiry.
why_relevant: Main risk for any help desk: it must never help paper-only 'visthapit' claims; verify against original records.

title: PM-KUSUM Rajasthan (RRECL) State Solar Water Pumping portal
what_it_contains: Official Rajasthan application portal for PM-KUSUM Component B standalone solar pumps (up to 7.5 HP central subsidy).
why_relevant: Diggi + sprinkler + solar pump is the standard IGNP-chak setup; families in Khajuwala/Chhatargarh/Pugal chaks can apply in windows.

title: PM-KUSUM scheme page, MNRE
what_it_contains: Scheme components A/B/C, subsidy norms (30% central for Comp B, state adds share), deadline extended to 31 March 2026.
why_relevant: Official reference for the checklist; status after March 2026 must be re-checked (PM-KUSUM 2.0 talk).

title: KUSUM Rajasthan (RRECL) 2026 guide (vendor blog)
what_it_contains: Claims 60% subsidy (30+30), farmer pays ~10% (rest loan), 5 HP pump farmer share ~Rs 25,000-28,500; windows fill in 72 hours; Jamabandi from apnakhata needed.
why_relevant: Useful practical numbers but a vendor blog: verify on RRECL portal before publishing.

title: Raj Kisan Sathi portal (Agriculture Dept, Rajasthan)
what_it_contains: Single portal for farm subsidies: drip/sprinkler (Micro Irrigation Mission), diggi, farm pond, pipeline, machinery; login by Jan Aadhaar/SSO or via e-Mitra.
why_relevant: The one place where most farm subsidies for chak farmers are applied.

title: Raj Kisan: Diggi subsidy instructions page
what_it_contains: Official instruction page for diggi (on-farm storage) subsidy; page renders via script (content not machine-readable here).
why_relevant: Diggi is central in IGNP command; team should open in a browser and copy the conditions into the Hindi checklist.

title: Diggi Subsidy Scheme: up to Rs 3,40,000 (Krishi Jagran)
what_it_contains: Diggi subsidy up to Rs 3-3.4 lakh (75-85%), min 0.5 ha irrigated land, lined diggi min 4 lakh litres, sprinkler/drip mandatory; apply via Raj Kisan/e-Mitra; 2025 window to 30 June.
why_relevant: Explains the rule that sprinkler is compulsory with diggi: help families sequence applications.

title: Rajasthan Krishi Subsidy 2025 for Drip and Sprinkler (secondary)
what_it_contains: Small/marginal farmers 70-75% subsidy on drip/sprinkler; min 0.2 ha, max 5 ha; apply on Raj Kisan Sathi with Jan Aadhaar and land record.
why_relevant: Numbers for the checklist; verify each season.

title: Farm Pond (Khet Talai) Nirman Karyakram - myScheme
what_it_contains: Farm pond subsidy: SC/ST/marginal 70% or max Rs 73,500 (kachcha) and 90% or Rs 1,35,000 (plastic-lined); min 400 cubic metres.
why_relevant: Less central in canal chaks than diggi, but relevant for rainfed (barani) holdings in Kolayat/Pugal allotments.

title: Rajasthan Farmer Registry (AgriStack)
what_it_contains: Farmer ID registration linked to land records; Farmer ID mandatory for PM-KISAN instalments after March 2025; GP-level camps and CSC/e-Mitra.
why_relevant: Key trap for displaced families: land not in own name (pending 20B allotment, no mutation) = no Farmer ID = no PM-KISAN/MKSN. Help desk item #1.

title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Samman Nidhi 4th instalment (Amar Ujala)
what_it_contains: Rs 718 crore to ~72 lakh farmers; Rajasthan adds Rs 3,000/yr on top of PM-KISAN Rs 6,000 (total Rs 9,000).
why_relevant: Money at stake per farmer family if records are fixed.

title: Cabinet continues Modified Interest Subvention Scheme 2025-26 (PIB)
what_it_contains: KCC short-term loans up to Rs 3 lakh at 7%, 3% prompt repayment incentive -> effective 4%; Budget 2025-26 announced raising limit to Rs 5 lakh.
why_relevant: KCC is the cheapest credit; many chak farmers still borrow from arhtiyas.

title: Operative KCC crosses Rs 10 lakh crore (PIB)
what_it_contains: KCC coverage 7.72 crore farmers; collateral-free up to Rs 2 lakh.
why_relevant: Context and collateral-free limit for the checklist.

title: Empowering Annadatas: PMFBY (PIB)
what_it_contains: PMFBY: farmer premium 2% kharif, 1.5% rabi; from Kharif 2024 12% penalty interest on delayed claims; NCIP portal enrolment.
why_relevant: Guar/groundnut/moth crops in Bikaner chaks; help desk explains enrolment and claim intimation (72 hours).

title: SFAC Equity Grant and Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme
what_it_contains: FPO equity grant matching up to Rs 2,000/member, max Rs 15 lakh; credit guarantee for FPO loans.
why_relevant: Money available if families form or join an FPO.

title: 10,000 FPOs achieved under flagship scheme (PIB)
what_it_contains: 10,000 FPO target achieved; Rs 18 lakh management support per FPO over 3 years; CBBO handholding.
why_relevant: Evidence that the FPO route is funded; new FPOs need CBBO/NABARD support.

title: FPO Policy Rajasthan (Agriculture Dept, draft)
what_it_contains: Rajasthan state FPO policy: support for registration, working capital, market linkage.
why_relevant: State-level support for a future 34-gaon produce collective.

title: NCDEX 'Connecting Farmers to Market' newsletter, Oct 2025
what_it_contains: Investor Education/FPO awareness programmes on guar seed on 6 Oct 2025 at Lunkaransar (110 participants) and Pugal (70), 7 Oct Kuchor Athuni, 8 Oct Napasar and Palana (Bikaner).
why_relevant: Shows guar-seed FPO/market-linkage activity already reaching Lunkaransar and Pugal: a partner channel for price-risk training.

title: Ker Sangri received GI tag (Drishti)
what_it_contains: Ker sangri / sangri of khejri received Geographical Indication (reported April 2025).
why_relevant: GI-labelled sangri from Bikaner region can command premium; community produce idea.

title: Rajasthan's pride: Sangri of Khejri awaits GI tag (Down To Earth)
what_it_contains: GI application filed Dec 2024 by chairman of Khejdi Utpadan Avam Prasanskran Sahkari Society Ltd, Bikaner, with SKRAU (700-page dossier); sangri ~Rs 1,500/kg.
why_relevant: Bikaner-based cooperative + SKRAU are natural partners; families harvesting sangri from khejri in chaks could become authorised users.

title: A hardy desert fruit faces threats, putting women's incomes at risk (Mongabay India)
what_it_contains: Ker: wet Rs 250-300/kg, dried Rs 1,000-3,000/kg; women earn Rs 10,000-15,000/yr collecting; irrigation expansion causes ker root rot; SHGs in Jalore make ker products; Rajasthan Ker Production and Processing Development Society.
why_relevant: Warns that canal irrigation reduces ker: ker-sangri income is real but limited and declining in irrigated chaks.

title: Wool supply chain in Bikaner district (study)
what_it_contains: Bikaner is the hub of carpet-grade Chokla/Magra wool; farmer price problems, middlemen.
why_relevant: Reality check for a 'woollens' listing: raw wool is low-value.

title: Shear desperation: how can India's wool sector be revived (DTE)
what_it_contains: Wool prices fell sharply; best quality Rs 80-100/kg.
why_relevant: Figure is older; shows woollen products only make sense as finished craft, not raw wool.

title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme guide (secondary; official site pmvishwakarma.gov.in)
what_it_contains: Carpenter (Suthar/Badhai) eligible; Rs 15,000 toolkit e-voucher, up to Rs 3 lakh loan at 5% in two tranches; registration at CSC with biometric e-KYC.
why_relevant: Suthar families of the 34 gaon (Kanolai etc.) can use it for woodwork; ties to product listing.

title: Rajasthan Ustra Samrakshan (camel conservation) scheme (secondary)
what_it_contains: Rs 10,000 at camel calf birth + Rs 10,000 at one year (two instalments).
why_relevant: Camel-keeping families in Pugal/Kolayat belt; verify on Animal Husbandry dept site.

title: FSSAI FoSCoS: eligibility and fees by kind of business
what_it_contains: Basic registration for petty food business operators at Rs 100/year via foscos.fssai.gov.in.
why_relevant: Any ghee, ker-sangri or papad seller listed on 34gaon.com needs at least basic FSSAI registration.

title: Krishi Vigyan Kendra Bikaner-II (Lunkaransar)
what_it_contains: KVK Lunkaransar under SKRAU, est. 31 March 2012, ICAR-funded; trainings for farmers, farm women, rural youth; linkages with CAZRI, NRCC, RAJUVAS, NABARD, ATMA; recent pearl millet value-addition training.
why_relevant: Closest agri-science partner for the 34 gaon families; can vet farmer videos and host a 'ask a scientist' session.

title: Krishi Vigyan Kendra Bikaner-I
what_it_contains: KVK serving Bikaner district (Beechwal).
why_relevant: Second KVK; covers Khajuwala/Pugal side trainings.

title: SKRAU Directorate of Extension Education
what_it_contains: SKRAU runs KVKs Bikaner and Lunkaransar etc.; 373 trainings/9,466 participants in 2023-24; Kisan Mela (7,500 farmers, March 2023); ATIC single window; monthly e-paper 'Chokhi Kheti'; phone helpline by KVK scientists.
why_relevant: Kisan Mela and Chokhi Kheti are ready channels; team can re-share and record.

title: ICAR-CAZRI Regional Research Station Bikaner
what_it_contains: Work on limited-irrigation schedules, drip/sprinkler in agroforestry-horticulture, guar water stress, IGNP command productivity.
why_relevant: Exactly the canal-desert farming questions of the resettlement chaks.

title: ICAR-National Research Centre on Camel, Bikaner
what_it_contains: Camel research, milk products, trainings for herders and entrepreneurs.
why_relevant: Camel milk/products training for camel-keeping families; realistic only for a few.

title: MGSU Bikaner: list of affiliated colleges
what_it_contains: Affiliated colleges across Bikaner division incl. Khajuwala and Lunkaransar.
why_relevant: Map of nearby colleges for the student guidance page.

title: NCS: List of approved Model Career Centres
what_it_contains: Model Career Centre Bikaner at Sub-Regional Employment Office, Bikaner; job fairs, career counselling.
why_relevant: Free counselling and job fairs; a jobs board can re-post their notices.

title: ARO Jhunjhunu: Bikaner Agniveer recruitment rally notification
what_it_contains: Rally notification for Bikaner (ARO Jhunjhunu covers Bikaner, Churu, Jhunjhunu, Sri Ganganagar, Hanumangarh); secondary sources give 13 Aug-6 Sep 2025.
why_relevant: Army recruitment is a major youth aspiration here; jobs board posts CEE and rally dates.

title: High-speed connectivity to border areas top priority: Raj Chief Secretary
what_it_contains: Chief Secretary reviewed pending 4G tower land allotment in Bikaner; uncovered border villages to be connected on priority.
why_relevant: Confirms patchy connectivity in Bikaner border belt: design for voice/WhatsApp and offline, not heavy web apps.

title: Social Justice and Empowerment Dept, Rajasthan (Anuprati, scholarships, pensions)
what_it_contains: Nodal dept for Mukhyamantri Anuprati Coaching, post-matric scholarships (SJMS), Ekal Nari pension.
why_relevant: Official source for deadlines.

title: CM Anuprati free coaching: last date 30 Sept, 30,000 to benefit (Amar Ujala)
what_it_contains: 30,000 seats; free coaching (UPSC, RAS, JEE, NEET, CLAT, banking, SSC etc.); family income up to Rs 8 lakh; SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS; 50% seats for girls; Rs 40,000/yr for relocating; apply via SSO/e-Mitra.
why_relevant: Most OBC (Jat, Suthar etc.) families here qualify on income; a help desk can raise uptake.

title: Rajasthan Scholarships 2026 overview (Buddy4Study)
what_it_contains: Post-matric scholarship on SJMS; OBC income limit (reported) Rs 1 lakh (verify, may differ by scheme); 2026-27 window 15 Aug-31 Oct 2026; Jan Aadhaar mandatory.
why_relevant: Deadline 31 October 2026 makes this the first urgent task.

title: Kalibai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Yojana 2025-26
what_it_contains: Girls with 65% (RBSE)/75% (CBSE) in class 12; SC/ST and income limit; now cash in lieu of scooty reported.
why_relevant: Check category eligibility per current notification (other scooty schemes cover other categories).

title: Rajasthan's (Rajiv Gandhi) Career Guidance Portal
what_it_contains: Free career portal for class 9-12 of government schools (UNICEF-supported), 560+ careers, scholarships and exam lists in Hindi.
why_relevant: Ready-made career content; mentors can use it instead of building new.

title: Atal Gyan Kendra modern library attracts youth (Patrika, Churu)
what_it_contains: Atal Gyan Kendra at Tehnadeshar (Churu): 24 seats, 4 computers, AC, CCTV; opened 30 Jan 2026; all seats full.
why_relevant: Evidence the GP-level study centre model works; 34gaon mentors can add sessions there.

title: Rajasthan to open Atal Gyan Kendra in every gram panchayat
what_it_contains: Announced 25 Dec 2024; Rs 500 crore; library, e-library, career counselling, e-Mitra-like services; 'Atal Prerak'; phase 1 = GP HQs with >3,000 population.
why_relevant: Resettlement GPs (Chhatargarh/Khajuwala/Pugal) may get one; team should ask which GP has it.

title: Bikaner official news: rural service camps 30 June 2026
what_it_contains: Government rural service camps on 30 June 2026 incl. Sherpura (Chhatargarh), 25 KYD (Khajuwala), Gangajali (Pugal), Kapurisar and Gopalyan (Lunkaransar).
why_relevant: Government camps come to these GPs; a volunteer help desk should sit beside them with checklists.

title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana 2026 (secondary guide; applied via SSO, Dept of Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship)
what_it_contains: Unemployment allowance Rs 4,000 (men)/Rs 4,500 (women, disabled) for up to 2 years for graduates, family income < Rs 2 lakh, age 21-35 (40 reserved); 4 hours/day internship.
why_relevant: Graduates from poorer displaced families; also links to jobs.

title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarozgar Yojana: interest-free loan up to Rs 10 lakh (Zee Business)
what_it_contains: Launched 12 Jan 2026, to 31 March 2029; age 18-45; interest borne by state; 5-year repayment; apply via SSO.
why_relevant: Seed capital for youth enterprises (dairy, agri inputs, e-Mitra).

title: PM Internship Scheme portal
what_it_contains: 12-month internships in top companies, Rs 5,000/month; age 21-24, not in full-time job/education, family income < Rs 8 lakh; 10th/12th/ITI/diploma/graduates.
why_relevant: Realistic first job exposure for graduates who otherwise sit idle.

title: RKCL WCD: free RS-CIT, RS-CSEP, RS-CFA for women
what_it_contains: Free RS-CIT (needed for many state jobs) for women/girls 16-40, 10th pass, apply via MyRKCL/e-Mitra.
why_relevant: Direct, low-cost digital skill for women and girls in resettlement villages.

title: Increase in Ekal Nari Samman Pension (SJE)
what_it_contains: Monthly pension raise for single women (widow/divorced/abandoned).
why_relevant: Widows among elders; help desk item.

title: Mukhyamantri Vriddhjan Samman Pension Yojana (myScheme)
what_it_contains: Old-age pension: women 55+, men 58+, family income < Rs 48,000/yr; ~Rs 1,150/month, Rs 1,500 at 75+; ssp.rajasthan.gov.in.
why_relevant: Elders' entitlement.

title: Ayushman Vay Vandana cards for 70+ (AIR)
what_it_contains: All citizens 70+ get Rs 5 lakh/yr health cover under PM-JAY irrespective of income; enrol via Ayushman app/beneficiary.nha.gov.in with Aadhaar e-KYC.
why_relevant: Simplest high-value action for elders: one sitting with a phone.

title: Varishth Nagrik Tirth Yatra 2026 applications (ETV Bharat)
what_it_contains: Devasthan dept senior citizen pilgrimage scheme opened, ~56,000 elders; lottery; apply via edevasthan SSO.
why_relevant: Popular with elders; annual window.

title: Lado Protsahan Yojana (Rajasthan)
what_it_contains: Rs 1.5 lakh savings bond for girls born on/after 1 Aug 2024 in govt/JSY hospitals, in 7 instalments to graduation; auto-registration at ANC.
why_relevant: Families need to know to keep hospital birth and bank details in order.

title: Rajeevika (RGAVP) - Rajasthan Grameen Aajeevika Vikas Parishad
what_it_contains: ~48.85 lakh households in 4.11 lakh SHGs (Feb 2025); Lakhpati Didi; SHG products sold at fairs (Rs 60 lakh at Bikaner House, 2025).
why_relevant: Women in resettlement villages can join SHGs for credit and product sales; product listing should route through SHGs.

title: Rajasthan Sampark (CM Helpline 181)
what_it_contains: Grievance filing online/181/Sampark centres at GP; grievance ID tracking.
why_relevant: Escalation path for stuck applications, including allotment files.

title: Jan Soochna Portal: Information of Schemes
access: round 1: not opened from this machine; open in browser
what_it_contains: Scheme info, beneficiary lists and eligibility checker (181 schemes of 19 departments).
why_relevant: Help desk can check a family's benefit status without RTI.

title: myScheme find-scheme (Govt of India)
what_it_contains: Eligibility-based search across central and state schemes.
why_relevant: Second checker for volunteers.

title: NHPC 300 MW Karnisar-Bhatiyan (Pugal tehsil) solar plant foundation (PIB)
what_it_contains: NHPC 300 MW plant at Karnisar-Bhatiyan, Poogal tehsil, Rs 1,732 crore.
why_relevant: CSR and local jobs from a CPSU sited in Pugal tehsil - approach its CSR cell.

title: Pugal Solar Park 2,450 MW + 5,000 MWh BESS
what_it_contains: RSDCL (RRECL subsidiary) park on 4,353 ha govt land in Pugal tehsil; Rs 18,000 crore investment.
why_relevant: Developers here will have CSR obligations and O&M jobs.

title: CSR activities by NLC India (Barsingsar)
what_it_contains: NLCIL set up an ITI at Barsingsar (welder, fitter, electrician, horticulture; Rs 25 lakh), oxygen plant at PBM Bikaner, ALIMCO aids camp.
why_relevant: Proven CSR precedent in Bikaner district for skills; NLC also has 300 MW solar at Barsingsar.

title: Karnataka's Pavagada Solar Park fails locals (Pulitzer Center)
what_it_contains: Large solar park delivered few local jobs.
why_relevant: Warning: don't promise solar jobs; aim for specific O&M/security trainings and CSR grants.

title: J-PAL: Evaluation of Digital Green's extension program in India (Bihar)
what_it_contains: RCT in 420 villages: no significant adoption effect (partial adoption not captured), yields +18% (228 kg/acre) in video arm, profits +9-24%; cost Rs 96/farmer vs benefits Rs 590-5,224.
why_relevant: Evidence for farmer-to-farmer video; also shows limits.

title: Evidence review of Digital Green's video-mediated extension
what_it_contains: Summary of trials: Ethiopia RCT reach +24%, uptake up to +44%; cost per adoption $3-6 at saturation.
why_relevant: Model design for short Bagri videos.

title: Farmer.CHAT (Digital Green + Gooey.AI)
what_it_contains: AI farm assistant in Hindi etc., voice/photo queries; 60 Decibels Kenya study 2025: 7 in 10 applied advice.
why_relevant: A free tool volunteers can demo; not a substitute for KVK.

title: J-PAL: Learning camps (Pratham TaRL), Uttar Pradesh
what_it_contains: 10-20 day camps: 49% could read a paragraph vs 24% control; materials-only had no language impact.
why_relevant: Summer learning camp model for primary children in resettlement villages.

title: J-PAL: Teaching at the Right Level evidence
what_it_contains: Six RCTs in 7 Indian states; among most cost-effective education programmes.
why_relevant: Justifies choosing TaRL over tuition-style help.

title: ASER 2024 national findings
what_it_contains: Std III govt school children reading Std II text 23.4% (2024); ~90% of 14-16 year-olds have smartphone access; girls use less.
why_relevant: Baseline for why foundational learning help is needed and phones are the channel.

title: Gram Vaani: Mobile Vaani - a social media platform for rural masses
what_it_contains: Missed-call IVR voice platform; >100,000 monthly users in Bihar/Jharkhand; culture, schemes, grievances.
why_relevant: Voice model fits Bagri speakers; full IVR likely too costly for a few thousand families.

title: Evaluation of JEEViKA Mobile Vaani among rural women in Bihar
what_it_contains: Quasi-experimental; only 23% of women interviewed had heard of Mobile Vaani.
why_relevant: Shows reach is the hard part; need offline promotion.

title: Exotel pricing (cloud telephony/IVR)
what_it_contains: Entry plan ~Rs 9,999 for 5 months with IVR and one virtual number; per-minute usage extra.
why_relevant: Cost basis for a possible voice line.

title: WhatsApp Business Platform pricing
what_it_contains: Per-message pricing from July 2025; India ~Rs 0.12 utility, ~Rs 0.87 marketing (secondary sources); service replies free until Oct 2026 change.
why_relevant: Free WhatsApp Business app + Channel is enough at this scale.

title: Barefoot College: Solar Mamas
what_it_contains: Tilonia (Ajmer): 6-month residential training of rural women as solar engineers; claims 75,000+ households electrified.
why_relevant: Rajasthan-born model; relevant as skills-for-women idea (solar pump repair) - but no formal impact evaluation found.

title: SEWA Trade Facilitation Centre (craft women, Banaskantha/Kutch)
what_it_contains: 15,000 artisans in 500+ producer groups; on-the-spot payment, raw material banks, women set prices.
why_relevant: Desert craft collective model; shows scale needs years and a professional team.

title: Rang De P2P social lending
what_it_contains: Loans at 4-8% via field partners in 14 states; ~93% to women; near-full repayment claimed.
why_relevant: Possible credit for women's micro-enterprises via a field partner, not direct.

title: Milaap crowdfunding pricing (0% platform fee)
what_it_contains: 0% platform fee crowdfunding for education/medical.
why_relevant: Occasional individual education appeals; privacy and dignity concerns.

title: Mentor Together (India)
what_it_contains: 7,000+ mentorships; self-reported: 77% better career decisions, 71% more confidence.
why_relevant: Model for structured, safeguarded mentoring (not just a directory).

title: Rajasthan Jat Hostels: Bikaner
what_it_contains: Community hostels network offering housing plus mentorship for students.
why_relevant: Existing samaj infrastructure for students moving to Bikaner city.

title: Pushkarna Seva Parishad Bikaner pratibha samman: 175+ students (Voice of Bikaner)
what_it_contains: Community body honours 10th/12th students with 70%+ each year.
why_relevant: Local precedent for a 34-gaon pratibha samman / book fund.

title: Samrathal Foundation Society, Jodhpur (donor dashboard)
what_it_contains: Education support NGO (Bishnoi and rural Rajasthan): scholarships, mentoring; public donor dashboard.
why_relevant: Model of a samaj-rooted scholarship society with transparency; details not machine-readable.

title: Karya: dignified digital data work
what_it_contains: Rural workers paid ~$5/hour for data tasks in own language; 100,000 workers; supplementary not permanent work.
why_relevant: Only realistic 'remote work' route at scale; works via partner organisations.

title: World Bank: Working Without Borders - online gig work (2023)
what_it_contains: Online gig demand grew 41% 2016-2023; over half of workers are youth; risks: low pay, instability.
why_relevant: Evidence to temper freelancing expectations.

title: Skills training and employment outcomes in rural Bihar (IZA DP 10902)
what_it_contains: DDU-GKY: +29 pp employment right after training, falls to zero 2-6 months later.
why_relevant: Warns that short skilling without local jobs does not stick.

title: J-PAL: job information during vocational training
what_it_contains: Two information sessions on real job conditions -> trainees 18% more likely to stay in placed jobs.
why_relevant: Mentors from the community giving honest job information is itself effective.

title: DPDP Rules 2025 notified (PIB)
what_it_contains: DPDP Rules notified 13-14 Nov 2025; phased 18 months; consent manager Nov 2026; remaining obligations May 2027; children's data needs verifiable parental consent (Rule 10).
why_relevant: Directory, scholarship and help-desk data must follow DPDP now.

title: DPDP Rule 10 (children's data, verifiable parental consent)
what_it_contains: Text of Rule 10: verifiable consent of parent before processing a child's (under 18) personal data.
why_relevant: Scholarship applicants and mentees under 18.

title: Trust vs Society vs Section 8 company (Patron Accounting)
what_it_contains: Trust registration cheapest (~Rs 6,000-20,000); Section 8 ~Rs 14,000-25,000 + Rs 12,000-25,000/yr compliance; 12A/80G via Form 10A; CSR-1 needed for CSR funds.
why_relevant: Choice of legal form for a fund.

title: Pavagada solar park: communities still await jobs (Land Conflict Watch)
what_it_contains: Documented gap between promised and delivered local jobs.
why_relevant: Same caution for Pugal solar park expectations.

title: Thirty years of Hoshangabad Science Teaching Programme 1972-2002: a review (Eklavya)
what_it_contains: HSTP scaled from 16 schools to 800+ schools in 15 MP districts; ~2.5 lakh students over 30 years; closed by state government in 2002.
why_relevant: Lesson: work with government institutions (schools, Atal Gyan Kendra), not parallel to them; volunteer programmes die without institutional home.
